title: CYCLIC-BLOCKLOG: balanced wide-root block decoding with separately capped denser seeds

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single CYCLIC-BLOCKLOG algorithm in the supplied full proofs recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on every execution branch, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 2^J(n)). Here J(n)=a sqrt(n)+(9/2)sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^2-7sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^4+23sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^6 and F(n)=a sqrt(n)-(5/2)sqrt(n)/(log2 n)+6sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^2, with exact Pell rational  of cyclic_base.md Section 0. These eventual positive representative envelopes are evaluated for n>=2^1024 and extended positively on the finite smaller prefix; the algorithm and correctness apply to every N. All constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. The algorithm fixes the full proof.md configuration, including base scale 8/9, wide-root lambda(b)=2b+2t+40, small-width threshold 2^20(t+1)^2, counted rational parameters, denser seed increment 2t, actual recomputed maxima and decoder/extractor parameters, separate seed/other acquisition caps 4096 U_seed and 4096 U_other, and all finite/mode branches. Every failed, rejected, discarded and cutoff-abandoned acquisition is counted. The exact growth index is 1/2.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
